text: Cyclin-CDK complexes drive transitions between cell cycle phases, and tumor suppressors such as p53 and Rb help regulate checkpoints including the G1/S restriction point.
explanation: Cyclin-CDK complexes drive each cell cycle transition, and tumor suppressor proteins like p53 and Rb, together with oncogenes, form the network logic controlling checkpoints such as the G1/S restriction point, G2/M, and the spindle assembly checkpoint. This statement directly reflects the chapter's description of cell cycle control.
